THE MANY PROBLEMS OF MONEY MOVEMENT

In this world there are many problems for send money to others, if you tried for example traditional money movement, you can get many times these problems: 

⬛️HIGH COST

Average 6-8% fees for sending money internationally (World Bank data)

⬛️SLOW SETTLEMENT

from 2 to 5 days for fiat transfers via correspondent banking

⬛️MULTIPLE INTERMEDIARIES

Banks, payment processors, FX providers each taking cuts

⬛️UNRELIABLE LAST MILE

Off-ramps in emerging markets (for example Philippines, Africa etc) suffer from liquidity gaps and failed deliveries

⬛️CONTROL AND ANALYSIS SYSTEM

Legacy blockchain solutions require wrapping assets, introducing security vulnerabilities and capital inefficiency

You can how many problems and delay there are for just sending some money, in this case @codexfx can solve these problems!

HOW CODEX SOLVES IT

🟨Native Stablecoin Infrastructure:

- No Bridging Required: Direct native USDC issuance on Codex Chain via Circle, burn on source chain, mint canonically on destination

- Stablecoin Gas Fees: Pay transaction costs in USDC/USDT instead of volatile crypto assets

- Result: Eliminates wrapped asset risks and simplifies user experience

🟨Instant Settlement with Codex FX:

- Wholesale FX Layer: Onchain foreign exchange for 0 day settlement across fiat/stablecoin pairs

- Result: Convert USD to another value instantly at institutional rates, not retail spreads

🟨Atomic On/Off-Ramps

- Validator Slashing: Validators stake collateral, so if fiat delivery fails, they lose stake and guaranteeing recipient gets funds

- Onchain Compliance: Compliance checks happen atomically; failed transactions revert before execution

- Result: Risk free delivery with built in accountability, no more frozen funds or failed transfers

🟨Cost Structure:

- Predictable Low Fees: Codex delivers predictable, low transaction costs, regardless of network congestion or market conditions. Payments and FX trades can't tolerate noisy neighbors.

- No Intermediary Cuts: Direct peer to peer with programmatic settlement

- Result: Fees drop from 6-8% to less of 1% with sub second finality

Codex for me is one of project where i think is good to make a look! #CodexChristmas

Pahirapan ring makalabas ng EDSA sa bahagi ng Scout Borromeo dahil sa bumper-to-bumper na daloy ng mga sasakyan.

Here are the other solutions offered by MMDA to ease the heavy traffic along Marcos Highway.
